$sources: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 7 (snow loads): Sec 7.2 ground snow loads by risk category, 7.3 flat roof snow load, 7.4 sloped roofs, 7.7-7.8 drifts

B-fullyExposed.description: Surface roughness B, roof fully exposed

B-partiallyExposed.description: Surface roughness B, roof partially exposed

C-fullyExposed.description: Surface roughness C, roof fully exposed

C-partiallyExposed.description: Surface roughness C, roof partially exposed

D-fullyExposed.description: Surface roughness D, roof fully exposed

D-partiallyExposed.description: Surface roughness D, roof partially exposed

aboveTreeline-fullyExposed.description: Above the tree line in windswept mountains, roof fully exposed

aboveTreeline-partiallyExposed.description: Above the tree line in windswept mountains, roof partially exposed

alaskaTreeless-fullyExposed.description: Alaska, no trees within 2 miles, roof fully exposed

alaskaTreeless-partiallyExposed.description: Alaska, no trees within 2 miles, roof partially exposed

sources.factor: ASCE 7-22 Sec 7.3, Eq 7.3-1: pf = 0.7 Ce Ct pg (pg of the risk category's map, Sec 7.2; no importance factor, so importance is empty)
sources.exposures: ASCE 7-22 Table 7.3-1, Ce by surface roughness B, C, D and above the tree line / Alaska without trees, and the roof's exposure (id: roughness-exposure)
sources.thermal: ASCE 7-22 Table 7.3-2: Ct 1.0 (heated, the default); enter 1.1 (kept just above freezing, cold ventilated roofs), 1.2 (unheated and open air), 1.3 (kept below freezing), 0.85 (continuously heated greenhouses) as the project's Ct (the categories of the earlier edition; see VERIFY.md)
sources.slope: ASCE 7-22 Sec 7.4, Figure 7.4-1: Cs for warm roofs (Ct <= 1.0), cold roofs Ct = 1.1 and Ct >= 1.2, slippery / other surfaces, to 0 at 70 degrees
sources.minimum: ASCE 7-22 Sec 7.3.3: low-slope roofs (below 15 degrees), pm = pg up to 20 psf (0.96 kN/m²), 20 psf above
sources.loadCase: ASCE 7-22 Sec 2.3.1: S is its own load (1.2D + 1.6(Lr or S or R) ..., 0.2S with E); SAEngine applies it to the roof slabs as case S
sources.drift: ASCE 7-22 Sec 7.8, Eq 7.8-1 (leeward drift with the winter wind parameter W2), windward drift 3/4 of it with the lower roof's length, w = 4 hd, hd <= hc with w = 4 hd²/hc <= 8 hc; lu at least 20 ft
sources.seismicShare: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.7.2(4): 20 % of the uniform design snow load where the flat roof snow load exceeds 30 psf (1.44 kN/m²)
